enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Reverberating 2: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to pulse with sound, dealing 2d6 sonic damage on each hit.
Construct Bane 2: This weapon is attuned specifically to disrupt creations, dealing an additional 2d10 bane damage vs. Constructs.
Armor-Piercing 7%: Passive: +7% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
